name: Merddin
text: Merddin is a variant spelling of Myrddin, the Welsh poet and prophet who fed the figure of Merlin in Arthurian tradition.

attributes.attribute: Welsh form behind the Arthurian Merlin figure

okr.objective: Documents Merddin as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: The entry is a spelling cross-reference to Myrddin.
Myrddin lies behind the Arthurian Merlin.
